as_told.title: Pat Price finds a Soviet submarine with a UFO tracking it
as_told.place_text: Ocean location of a Russian 'boomer' submarine

plain: In the 1970s, a psychic named Pat Price, using what is called remote viewing (describing distant places by the mind alone), is said to have located a Soviet missile submarine, a "boomer", and found "a huge UFO right over the top of the water where that thing was and it was tracking it and monitoring it." The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this on two episodes and says he saw it himself: he says it was "in the file" of reports that Ingo Swann, another psychic in the same work, sent to the Guardian's Office, an internal arm of the Church of Scientology, and he also names the physicist Russell Targ, who worked with them. If true, it would mean a UFO was keeping watch on a Soviet nuclear submarine.
